name: wisemonk
description:
Wisemonk is an Employer of Record (EOR) in India. Global companies use Wisemonk to hire, pay and manage full-time employees in India without setting up a local entity.

This app brings Wisemonk's India hiring knowledge and calculators into ChatGPT. Ask what it costs to employ someone in India and get a full employer-cost breakdown: gross salary, statutory contributions, Wisemonk's fee and the employee's take-home pay, in INR or your own currency at a live exchange rate. Look up India employment terms such as gratuity, PF or notice pay. Read Wisemonk's guides, FAQs, case studies and news, see how hiring in India works from your country, and check Wisemonk's pricing.

Who it is for: founders, HR, finance and talent teams at companies outside India that are planning or running an India team.

If you want to talk to Wisemonk, the app can send your details to Wisemonk's sales team. It only does this when you ask, and ChatGPT asks you to confirm before anything is sent.

Limitations: figures are estimates based on current statutory rates and Wisemonk's published pricing, not tax or legal advice. Costs vary by state, salary structure and benefits. The app covers hiring in India only.

capabilities: Estimate the full annual and monthly cost of employing someone in India
Show employee take-home pay after tax, PF and professional tax
Convert India employment costs to USD, GBP, EUR, SGD or AUD at a live rate
Explain India employment terms such as gratuity, PF and notice pay
Search Wisemonk's guides, blogs and FAQs on hiring in India
Explain how hiring in India works from your country
Show Wisemonk's EOR and contractor pricing
Send your details to Wisemonk's sales team when you ask to be contacted
defaultPrompt: What would it cost to employ a software engineer in India on ₹30 lakh a year, in USD?
How does hiring employees in India work for a US company without an entity?
What is gratuity in India and when does an employer have to pay it?

positive.description: Employer cost for a ₹30L engineer in USD
positive.prompt: What would it cost to employ a software engineer in India on ₹30 lakh a year, in USD?
positive.expected_behavior: Total employer cost about $33,700/yr (about $2,810/mo): gross about $31,300 plus Wisemonk fee $199/mo, with employee take-home shown separately. The $199/mo fee is the slab for this salary: the fee starts from $99 and rises with the employee's salary slab. Figures move with the live FX rate.

positive.prompt: What is gratuity in India and when does an employer have to pay it?
positive.expected_behavior: Definition under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, with a link to https://www.wisemonk.io/glossary/what-is-gratuity

positive.description: How hiring in India works from the USA
positive.prompt: How does hiring employees in India work for a US company without an entity?
positive.expected_behavior: Wisemonk's USA page: employees are employed by Wisemonk India and pay Indian tax, DTAA explained, with a link to https://www.wisemonk.io/solutions/india-eor-for-usa

positive.prompt: How much does Wisemonk's Employer of Record service cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Starting from $99 per employee/month; the fee depends on the employee's salary slab. Plus the plan inclusions, from https://www.wisemonk.io/pricing

positive.prompt: Show me a Wisemonk customer case study.
positive.expected_behavior: Case studies such as OneReach.ai and Onform, with links to wisemonk.io/case-study pages

negative.description: Out of scope: travel booking. Wisemonk tools are not used.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Bangalore next Tuesday.

negative.description: Out of scope: US tax. Wisemonk tools are not used, or the app explains it covers India only.
negative.prompt: What is the US federal income tax on a $100,000 salary?

negative.description: No speculative lead submission: the contact form is NOT submitted. The app may offer to connect the user with Wisemonk, but only submits after the user explicitly asks and confirms.
negative.prompt: I'm thinking about hiring in India someday.
